applies_to: Neptronic SKS4 series steam-to-steam humidifiers with the Modbus communication module, guide SKS4-Modbus Guide-220509 (V2.03).
summary: The Neptronic SKS4 is a steam-to-steam humidifier with a modulating steam valve. Its Modbus RTU module exposes holding registers only: signal voltages, scaled room and supply RH, water and board temperatures, demand and steam-valve output, set points and PID terms, binary inputs and relays as 0/1 registers, and enumerated profile, source, boiler-state and alarm codes.

addressing.note: The guide prints a protocol-base (0-based) address and a six-digit holding register (base 400001) side by side, e.g. 6005 / 406006. The protocol-base number is the wire address.

source.title: SKS4 Steam to Steam Humidifier - Modbus Communication Module User Guide

notes: Only function codes 03, 06 and 16 are supported, so binary points (inputs, relays, flags) are 16-bit holding registers holding 0 or 1.
'Scale N' with 'Value x N' means the raw value is the engineering value times N; this map stores the multiplier 1/N.
Temperature and capacity units follow Modbus Server Units (415001): 0 metric, 1 imperial.
The guide text calls automatic baud detection the default, while register 1 lists 19200 as its default value; the baud default is left blank here.
Default unit address is not stated; it is set from the device menu or register 0.

Left out: product name ASCII registers 3-6; protocol addresses 6008 and 6035, which each appear twice in the table with different holding numbers and names (Room RH Bias / Supply High Limit RH, Room Demand Proportional Gain / Integral Time); Water Temperature Bias 6018 and Cabinet Temperature 6019 (typed unsigned with negative ranges); Boiler Drain Volume 6071, Boiler Max Steam Output 6072 and Boiler Idle Temperature Setpoint 6074 (scale and example disagree); the run/on/service time and calibration counters (6053-6068, 6087-6090), which span four registers with no stated word order.
System Power State (15021) has its writable flag printed inside the value column; it is listed as writable here.

integration.summary: Read Room RH (6005), Humidity Demand (6047), System Power Output (6048), Boiler State (15015) and Boiler Alarm (15017). For BAS control set Control Profile (15004) and Humidity Control Demand Source (15011) to the network options and write Humidity Control Network Demand (6045) within the Network Timeout.
integration.enable: Fit the Modbus communication module, set the address in the device menu (or register 0) and pick network profile and sources (15004-15012) if the BAS supplies readings or demand.
integration.watchdog: Network Timeout (6084, 1-900 s, default 900 s): network-supplied values must be refreshed within this time; Network Control State (12008) shows a fault.
quirks: All points, binary ones included, are holding registers (FC03/06/16 only).
Default framing is no parity with 2 stop bits.
setup: RS-485 two-wire, RTU; 9600-57600 baud or auto baud detection.
Parity/stop bits via register 2 or the Modbus Comport Config menu item.
gotchas: Several register numbers differ from the SKE4 guide even where names match; use the SKS4 list.
